props.name: altText

props.name: imageColumn

props.name: altColumn
props.help: The column on the element context (for example DataLoaderSingle) containing the alt text. This will override both alt text set via Media tab or altText above; unconnect to use those.

props.name: defaultLocation
props.help: Where to center the map if a user's location cannot be found. Format: [lat, lng]

props.name: markerPositionsColumn
props.help: The column with the location info

props.name: customIconColumn
props.help: Optionally show images on the markers from this column

props.name: markerLabelColumn
props.help: A number or letter to put in the marker

props.name: markerTitleColumn
props.help: A title to show on the map above the marker

props.name: checkedProperty
props.help: A DataAnnotation to use for displaying a check mark in the marker

props.name: mapId
props.help: An individual identifier, change only if you have multiple maps open at the same time

props.name: inline
props.help: Show a map with rounded corners

props.name: nearestElementMode
props.help: Show only the marker closest to the user's position

props.name: disableControls
props.help: prevent user from zooming and panning

props.name: singleElementContext
props.help: The map shows a single marker defined by a single element context.

props.name: tileLayer
props.help: A tile url, for example https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png

props.name: mapBoxGLStyle
props.help: The url to a a vector map style json, for example from MapTiler (takes precedece over tileLayer if set)

props.help: List available language codes, for example "en,de". The first is the default language.

props.name: includeOnlyAnnotated
props.help: Filter to only include elements that have a Data Annotation set to "true", for example "bookmarked". You can list multiple anotations with "checked, bookmarked".

props.name: excludeAnnotated
props.help: Filter to exclude elements that have a Data Annotation set to "true", for example "checked". You can list multiple anotations with "checked, bookmarked".

props.name: discoverableColumn
props.help: When you set discoverability to true, elements are hidden by default, until the receive the data annotation specified below

props.name: discoverAnnotation
props.help: The data annotation to use for discovering elements.

props.name: referenceColumn
props.help: The column that contains references to the elements we want to select. Which element to use is determined through the "element" context.
